description.en: Dotted thought-orb loading indicators for AI & agent interfaces. Nine hand-tuned animated states on a 2D canvas — no WebGL, works identically everywhere.
description.zh: 专为 AI 与 Agent 界面打造的点阵粒子思维光球：纯 2D Canvas 呈现 9 种精调动画态，无 WebGL，全浏览器表现一致。

content.en: Thinking Orbs offers organic, particle-based thought indicators purpose-built for generative AI assistants, chat interfaces, and autonomous agent loops. Rendered entirely on a plain 2D canvas with zero WebGL overhead or shader incompatibilities, it runs at flawless 60fps across Chrome, Safari, and Firefox. It ships with 9 hand-crafted state transitions—including thinking waves, listening audio ripples, search spirals, error shakes, and completion bursts—each tuned in both compact and regular sizes.
content.zh: Thinking Orbs 是一套专为生成式 AI 助手、智能体（Agent）工作流打造的点阵粒子思维光球指示器。不同于常规 WebGL 着色器在低端设备或不同浏览器间的渲染兼容隐患，它完全基于原生 2D Canvas 绘制，在 Chrome、Safari、Firefox 上表现严丝合缝。内置 9 种手工调校的生命周期动态——包括空闲自旋、深度思考波纹、语音监听波动、发散搜索螺旋、错误抖动与完成绽放，提供紧凑与常规两档标准尺寸。
